name: Warudobu
source:
The mysterious person who has taken control of the park by making hostages of its management. He claims he intended to blow up the park as punishment for making people throw away their money. The reason for his game has yet to be revealed.

[From [url=http://sweet-fuse.com/characters/]official website[/url]]
